motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Tch, is it over for me? There must be something more I can do...

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: It won't end like this... We WILL have our revenge!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Welrod Mark II. I've been waiting, Commander. Let us begin our mission for today.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: What is it? Please send an encrypted message if it is an order.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Tired already? Please leave the rest of the paperwork to me. I do have some experience with it.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: I'm getting another cup of tea. Would you like one as well?

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Costumes like these do not scare me. Things that are dead...will simply return to the darkness.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Huh?! What is this?<>...Eh? For me? Doing this in front of all these people, you're pulling my leg, aren't you?<>Ah...alright, just this once!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: I'm looking at pictures from when we went to the museum together. You were standing way too close, Commander...but...I'm fine with that.

motions.name: login
motions.line: Welrod Mark II. I've been waiting, Commander. Let us begin our mission for today.
